gloss: do a third time, devide into three parts
definition: I. [ שִׁלֵּשׁ ] Pi`el denominative do a third time, devide into three parts , etc.; — Perfect 2 masculine singular וְשִׁלַּשְׁתָּ֫ Deut 19:3 divide land into three parts (so Imperfect וַיְשַׁלֵּשׁ אֶתהָֿעָם [for ᵑ0 וַיְשַׁלַּח ] 2Sam 18:2 ᵐ5 L Bu ); 1Sam 20:19 stay three days (compare Dr ); v 1Sam 20:20 We Dr and others (compare ᵐ5 ) read ׳ אֲשַׁלֵּשׁ בַּ (for ׳ שְׁלשֶׁת הַ ) = I will shoot on the third day with the arrows ( HPS question); Imperfect 3 masculine plural וַיְשַׁלֵּ֑שׁוּ 1Kgs 18:34 , and Imperative masculine plural שַׁלֵּ֑שׁוּ v 1Kgs 18:34 do a third time. Pu`al Participle מְשֻׁלָּשׁ three years old Gen 15:9 + 1Sam 1:24 (read with ᵐ5 Th We etc. בְּפַר מְשֻׁלָּשׁ for בְּפָרִם שְׁלשָׁה ), feminine מְשֻׁלֶּשֶׁת Gen 15:9 (twice in verse); הַחוּט הַמְשֻׁלָּשׁ Eccl 4:12 the threefold cord ; female plural מְשֻׁלָּשׁוֺת Ezek 42:6 three-storied chambers.
